english: I'm booored, nyo.\nThere's nothing to do, nyo.
No word from Tesla-chan and the others yet...
I wonder if they're all right?
Once we've decided to trust them,\nworrying won't help.
I know, let's go to Akihabara... nyo!
What are you saying!\nWe don't know when that Gustav thing\nmight fire!
Um... I-I'd also like, just a little,\nto go back to Akihabara once... I'm sorry,\nI'm being selfish...!
(Soniko-san mistook this for a photoshoot\nand ended up coming all the way here.)
(Right, it'd be better\nto send Soniko back to her world.)
(I see. So, shall we go?)
Kurumi-san is still in this world,\nso if anything happens\nshe'll come tell us right away.
Huh? So we're going to Akihabara?
Yaaay!!
If she finds out we went to Akihabara,\nKurumi's gonna be the angriest...
Well, as long as we come right back, it's fine, no?
//Fade to black.\n//Background: Akihabara.
Akihabara! Dejiko's back, nyo!
Just the people we can see now\nprobably outnumber Hinamizawa's population.
It doesn't compare to Okinomiya either.
We can't stay long,\nso let's start with what needs doing.
Then let's go to Gamers, nyo!\nI'm gonna see the manager, nyo!
//Background: inside Gamers.
Managerrr.\nDejiko's returned, nyo!
//Dejiko runs to the back.\n//Everyone looks around the store.
Huh, this shop\neven carries photo books.
Oooh, nice nice!\nOjisan's getting tempted.
Sis, that's crude.
Huh? Isn't this Soniko-chan?
Huh! M-my photo book~!
Uwaaah!! It's true!!\nSoniko-san's famous!!
Amazing! Amazing!!\nHaving a photo book out\nmeans you're not a newbie anymore!
H-huh? Um...\nI-I've never put out\na photo book with this cover...
But this is you, Soniko-chan, right?\nIt's monochrome, but there's no mistaking it?
But... mm... it does\nlook exactly like me, but I really have\nno memory of shooting these photos...
So this is a knockoff?
Maybe I've just...\nforgotten...?
The manager was doing well, nyo~.
Ah, Dejiko! Take a look at this!
Hm? Soniko, when did you put out a photo book, nyo?
The thing is,\nshe says she's never shot photos like these.
Really, nyo?
Yes... I have no memory of\nthis outfit, the background, or the poses...
It's weird that something like this\nis even being sold, nyo!
Hm? The name part seems...\na little off...?
The name... Ah!\nIt doesn't say Super Sonico,\nit says Spaa Sonico!
That's not a typo, it's deliberate, isn't it?
You mean a fake?
Could it be...\na Black Soniko-chan, like Black Louise-chan\nand Black Twin Angel!?
A black me...?
A Black Soniko in this world...?
Where's Spaa Sonico's agency?\nLet's call them and storm in.
Don't do anything stupid, nyu.
Why not!
For an idol, a scandal like this\ndoes no good at all.
Right, nyo!\nTrouble just hurts your image\nand leads to nothing good, nyo!
(Coming from Dejiko, that's annoyingly convincing, nyu.)
Then what should we do?
Nyonyo!\nLeave such matters to the great Dejiko, nyo!
The fact that it's Dejiko's plan is what worries me...
Turn disaster into fortune, nyo!\nIf we're doing this, let's use the buzz\nand take the tasty bits for ourselves, nyo!
You have some brilliant plan that'd work that well?
There is, nyo!\nWe'll hold a "Super Sonico VS Spaa Sonico"\nshowdown event right here at Gamers, nyo!
A showdown event?
Since Black Soniko's in show business too,\nshe'll definitely jump on it once the buzz starts, nyo.
Then we hype it up properly,\nsettle it, and Soniko's popularity and fame\nwill skyrocket! Nothing but good, nyo!
A no-script real fight?\nSounds fun!
This is getting so exciting!\nI'm getting pumped!
Wawa! But a showdown,\nthat's so violent...!\nAnd I don't have confidence...
It's fine.\nThere's no way Soniko-san will lose.
You can win! Nico-chan can do it!
How can the real one be so timid?\nTake care of that fake\nin a flash!
U-um... quickly might be... hard...\nbut, b-but, since you're cheering me on,\nI'll do my best!
That's the spirit!
We'll cheer you on too!
Fight, Soniko-san!
Yes! I'll turn everyone's cheers into nipower\nand take on the challenge!
Then I'll go consult the manager, nyo!\nGet ready, nyo.
//Battle map: inside Gamers.\n//Ally placement; Soniko forced deployment in the center.
She's not showing up at all.\nDejiko, did you advertise properly?
I did, nyo!\nI got articles on news sites\nand handed out flyers all over Akihabara, nyo!
Will Spaa Sonico-san show up?
Just wait patiently, nyo.\nThese things spread gradually,\nnyo!
Is that how it goes?
//Black Soniko appears at the entrance.
She's here!
Um, a-are you Spaa Sonico-san...?
Hello, my fake.\nSetting up such a farce—\nsmall-timers are such a bother.
You're the fake!
U-um, I-I'm not a fake,\nI'm Super Sonico! Um!\nI'd like to ask about the photo book...
Fufufu, the photo book~?\nYou have no right to blame me~!\nYou barely even have work.
Ah... um, I-I do have work, h-humbly...!\nEven now...\na shoot...
Oh~? Work? A shoot, hmm.\nWell, whatever. After all,\nI'm going to take everything from you.
Huh?
Your work, your popularity, your fans.\nI'll take absolutely everything\nfrom you! And I will...!
Become the real one, you mean?
No~ no.\nI'm the real one to begin with.
I-I'm the real me too!
Then let's settle it here?\nWe don't need two Sonikos.
//Battle map: inside Gamers.\n//After enemy and ally placement.
Leave the nuisances to us—\nyou focus on the showdown!
Yes! I-I'll do my best!
Steady now. You'll be fine!
You're the real one, got it!
Um... by the way, what exactly\nshould I do for the showdown...?
Impression battles, chugging green juice, sexy pose battles—\nI've got all sorts planned,\nnyo~!
...No need for that.\nA showdown means a battle\nstaking everything we have, obviously~!
A b-battle? Staking... everything?
Or will you tuck your tail and run?
Wawa, I-I'll do it!
//Battle begins.\n//Talk event when Soniko and Black Soniko clash.
There's no way I can lose~!
Why... is that?
Because you're soft.\nI'm saying I'll take everything.\nDo you have that resolve? What can you do?
//Talk event when Soniko and Black Soniko clash again.
What's wrong~? You're no good at all~.
...Ungh...\nI really can't... fight...
Haa~. You're sweeter than a macaron.\n...So I'll end this for you.\nBecause I'm different from you!
D-different... from me...?\nMy...
Soniko-chan!! I'll save you now!
//Haruka tries to go help.
Wait! Right now,\nsomething inside her is about to change.\nLet's watch over her.
B-but...
Now, let's settle this!\nYour everything will be mine!
...My everything...\n...Everything... that's...
Soniko-chan! Hang in there!
This is where you hold on!
Nico-chan is Nico-chan!
Everyone...! That's right—\nthe memories of time spent with everyone...\nour bonds are precious to me... so I want to protect them...!
You're the real one!\nYou absolutely must win!
But I don't have that kind of power...!
No, you must!\nInside you, Soniko-san,\nthere must be the power of the Super Angel!
...Th-that was just me being desperate\nto save Haruka-chan and Aoi-chan!
That's it!
Huh?
Find the wings in your heart!\nThey'll become your own shining power!
My... heart's wings...?
//Soniko glows a little.
What is that~?\nYou think you can beat me\nwith something like a candle flame~?
M-my power may be tiny\nand unreliable...
But I'm not alone!\nI can hear it. The sound of wings flapping!
What are you even saying?\nThere's no such sound...
It's true! Listen...!
Huh?
Wait! Can't you really hear something?
Hm? What's that sound?
Fufun... I thought it was about time, nyo.
so...ko...so...ni...so...ni...ko
It's from outside! I hear lots of voices!
So-ni-ko! So-ni-ko! So-ni-ko!
This is...!
So-ni-ko! So-ni-ko! So-ni-ko!\nSo-ni-ko! So-ni-ko! So-ni-ko!\nSo-ni-ko! So-ni-ko! So-ni-ko!
I told you, nyo.\nAdvertising takes effect gradually, nyo!
But why from outside...?
This showdown is being filmed\nand streamed live online, nyo.\nAnd it's on the big screen outside too, nyo~.
So the people outside could tell\nSoniko-san was in trouble!
Everyone's giving me power.\nEnough to fly! This is...!
Yes! Your shining power!
So-ni-ko! So-ni-ko!
Ungh, ready... go!\nSuper Soniko, live on stage!\nHiyaaah!!
Yeeeaaah!
//Soniko emits a shining aura.\n//Battle resumes.
No way, impossible...
//Black Soniko vanishes. Any remaining grunts all vanish too.
...Um... did I do it right?
That was amazing!!
Nico-chan was so cool!
I wonder\nif everyone outside will give you the answer?
Now, go answer your fans' cheers.
Ah, y-yes!
//End of battle.\n//Background: in front of Gamers.
Everyooone!
Wooohooo!
Thank you for cheering me on!
Um... I can't put my feelings\ninto words right now...\nso may I express them with music!
Yeeeah!
Then, listen—Powerful Power!
//Event CG: Soniko live.
Ready...!!
Yeah! Yeah! Yeah! Yeah!
Oh, amazing!
Soniko-chaaan!!
This is the real Soniko-san!
Yes—the radiance of a true idol.\nNo, of a superstar.
(How about it, [CLAUDE].\nIdols are wonderful things, aren't they?)
(I can at least see that Soniko-san\nis making everyone here happy.)
(It's not just that.\nThis huge crowd is also making Soniko-san happy.\nDon't forget that.)
(Is that so... she does look happy,\nSoniko-san.)
What a lovely song.
I'm so moved... fehhn!!
Becoming one with the fans... truly amazing!
Yay!!
//Event CG off.\n//Background: inside Gamers.
Mufufu, thanks to the showdown event,\nsales exploded! Hurrah, nyo!
Talk about a merchant's spirit—\nor was that the plan from the start?
Events have to make everyone happy,\nnyo!
This time it's Dejiko-chan's achievement.
I raised Soniko!
That's not true!
Restrain yourself, nyu.
Silence.
It's a joke, nyo!\nBut Soniko's grown a lot, nyo.
Yeah, amazing~~!!
How wonderful!
I wonder if this means saying goodbye to Soniko.
I see, going back to work, huh.
With this many fans, of course.\n...I'll miss her, though.
Saying goodbye, huh, that's a shame...
After all, Soniko-chan only came\nto this different world\nbecause she got caught in Porial's light.
//Soniko arrives.
Good work, everyone!
Wawa, everyone looks down!\nThen, how about we go back to Saint Cherine Academy\nand have some snacks!
Huh? You're coming too, Soniko-chan??
Yes! I just promised\nall the fans cheering for me\nthat I'll come back even bigger!
Whaaat!?
I want to see my role through to the end\nbefore moving to the next step!\nPlease keep supporting me!
Uuugh, let's do this! Hiyaaah!
